name: optimize-decision-model
job: Model a decision for optimization: objective, constraints, sensitivity, with independently checkable recommended solutions.

inScope: Declaring decision owner, actions, entities, horizon, and baseline
Encoding hard constraints separately from soft preferences
Solving reproducibly and independently recomputing objective and constraints
Running sensitivity and stress analysis into a robust operating policy
outOfScope: Qualitative option selection without a mathematical program (decision-quality)
Calibrated prediction as the primary artifact (forecast-with-calibration)

inputs: Data with units, provenance, uncertainty, and missingness
Baseline policy and terminal decision artifact
outputs: Constrained Decision Model with formulation and tolerances
Feasibility evidence, solver configuration, result, bounds, and gap
Sensitivity, stress cases, robust policy, fallback, and re-solve triggers

data: inputs with reconciled meaning and units

failureSemantics: Solver success is not model validity; infeasibility keeps an explicit diagnostic instead of silently dropping constraints, and every material constraint is independently recomputed from the emitted solution.

outcome.observable: A Constrained Decision Model whose recommended solution an independent checker can recompute, with feasibility evidence, solver record, sensitivity analysis, and a robust operating policy with fallback and re-solve triggers.
